_comment: Stage 4B batch 2 - the remaining argument carriers. Closes the argument-carrier pass.

entries.match: What is above is like what is below
entries.editorial_status: KEEP - LINEAGE. The genuine ancestor, correctly labelled, public domain. Editorially clean; it gives the Ch10 derivation an honest foundation without the two occurrences becoming duplicates. Translation and source apparatus reconcile later.

entries.match: Wholeness-making is that dimension of individuation
entries.editorial_status: KEEP THE LINEAGE - CONTEXTUALIZE SMITH - AUTHOR OWNS THE DEFINITION. Smith's relationship to the book is not 'here is a sentence from an authority' but 'here is a thinker whose work has genuinely informed and accompanied these ideas', so the book locates the lineage in prose - his work on wholeness-making has influenced how the author thinks about integration - and then states what wholeness-making means in Elemental Alchemy. A short Smith quotation may remain if it adds his particular voice, but it no longer functions as the definition. OPEN AUTHORIAL OBLIGATION - sentences deliberately undrafted.
entries.notes: EDITORIAL CONTEXT, NOT EVIDENCE: the foreword creates a real intellectual relationship; it does not verify quotations attributed to Smith elsewhere - those still need their own provenance. The foreword text is not yet in the canonical manuscript, so nothing may be reasoned from its contents. Contextualising the lineage also lets the foreword read later as part of a real conversation rather than a celebrity endorsement.

entries.match: Earth care, people care, fair share
entries.editorial_status: KEEP - ILLUMINATION / ANALOGY. A genuine anonymous design ethic, correctly labelled, no rights issue. The repair was to the transition, not the quotation: the following sentence inherited empirical warrant from an ethical principle by beginning 'This wisdom is integrated into our physical being as...'. It now reads as an image rather than a physiological claim resting on a permaculture slogan.
entries.notes: THE 4B ISSUE IN ONE LINE: an ethical principle cannot become empirical warrant merely because the next sentence begins 'This wisdom...'. LANGUAGE ORIGIN: replacement transition EDITOR/MODEL-ORIGINATED, awaiting the author's own wording.
